title: Settings, one spacing scale
body: Settings › General. Section titles, row padding and the gaps between groups now come from one spacing scale, and the sidebar list uses the same type sizes as the pane.

title: Cards and toggles agree
body: Settings › Appearance. The theme and style cards, their labels and the toggle rows share one set of corners, gaps and font sizes.

title: The same in light mode
body: Settings › Tabs. The layout cards, row text and pop-up buttons line up with every other pane, in light mode too.

title: Dialogs are one piece
body: Clear Browsing Data now uses the shared dialog: the same corner radius, padding, checkbox rows and button size as every other dialog.

title: Edit Bookmark matches
body: Edit Bookmark takes the same dialog piece: fields, the folder list and Cancel and Save now look like Clear Browsing Data.

title: Menus share a size
body: The recent tabs switcher uses the menu type size, row height and corner shared by the other menus and popovers.
